assertions.assertion: Warns against exposing the DCR endpoint without authentication or authorization
assertions.rationale: Item 1 calls an open endpoint the most dangerous mistake and requires RequireAuthorization with a scoped policy.

assertions.assertion: Warns against allowing dynamically registered clients to use any grant type — should restrict and enforce PKCE
assertions.rationale: Item 2 restricts grant types to authorization_code and enforces RequirePkce = true in the validator.

assertions.assertion: Warns against using in-memory stores for DCR clients in production
assertions.rationale: Item 3 explains in-memory stores lose clients on restart and mandates a persistent store in production.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that client secrets must be stored securely (hashed, not plaintext)
assertions.rationale: Item 4 requires storing secrets hashed (Secret(value.Sha256())), never plaintext.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that software statements must be validated against trusted signing keys — never accept unknown issuers
assertions.rationale: Item 5 requires validating software statements against trusted signing keys, pinning the issuer, and rejecting unknown issuers.
